{{Top|leg}}
The '''Coming of the Prime Mover''' was an event in [[Ugor/Legends|Ugorian]] holy books, describing the arrival of the [[Prime Mover]], a chunk of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] containing a powerful [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]]. The switching on of the projector allowed the Ugorians to organize the vast junkyard of the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]].
